cm.c: Every 60 Seconds in Africa, A minute passes
Me watching this video for 70 seconds and realising that 280 babies were born and 140 people passed away
RIP to the 200 people who passed away while I was watching this
and that second never coming back in our life, ever
I'm sure someone on earth is sneezing every second.
So, 120 car incidents in just a minute. That’s scary
I think the 3 million text messages is just my group chat
instead of saying "give me a second" say "give me 4 costco hotdog sales"
At the factory an advertisement appeared on the information board: "as you read this pamphlet two children die in Africa". There was a campaign to remove the pamphlet to avoid more deaths.
